purpose: Teach: ことわざ/虫歯/ふんだんに/かぶり/豆乳/もてる/そういや/覗く

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お祖母ちゃんから、本気で、ことわざ、教えてもらった、絶対、本気で、心に、響いた、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Aoi — Granny taught me some real proverbs, and they actually hit me hard. I'm genuinely grateful.
lines.style: Soft, warm opening. Pause for reflection mid-thought. Sincere gratitude in the final phrase—not rushed. Tender in how she holds the memory.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。虫歯、本気で、絶対、なりやすい体質、メイちゃん、葵で、心配してるわよ、本気で、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yeah. But I worry about you getting cavities, honestly. You've got a real sweet tooth.
lines.style: Gentle concern wrapped in warmth. Not lecturing—just the quiet fussing of someone who notices and cares. Steady, knowing tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の店、本気で、絶対、お洒落な、雑貨、ふんだんに、置いてあるよね、メイちゃん、感心、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Your shop is so thoughtfully put together—all those lovely things everywhere. I really admire it.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, delivered slowly. Soft smile in the voice. Eyes lingering on details. No performance, just honest notice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、最近、本気で、絶対、可愛い帽子、買って、絶対、かぶり、楽しんでるのよ、メイちゃん、本気で、見に来てね、絶対。
lines.en: I've been having so much fun with this cute hat I bought lately. You should come by and see it.
lines.style: Light, playful energy. Aoi's warmth comes through as genuine delight in small things. Inviting, but not demanding. Natural brightness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、豆乳ベースの、本気で、絶対、新作ラテ、メニューに、加えませんか?本気で、絶対、お客様、喜びそう、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Have you thought about adding a soy-milk latte to the menu? I think your customers would really love it.
lines.style: Thoughtful suggestion, not pushy. Mei phrases it as a gift of an idea. Gentle, genuine—she cares about Aoi's success.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、もてる人ね、男性、いつも、葵で、見てるわよ、本気で、メイちゃん、誇り、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: You know, you're really someone people are drawn to. I see men looking your way all the time here at the shop.
lines.style: Warm observation, a little teasing affection underneath. Not flattery—just truth told with ease and pride in her friend.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そういや、葵、本気で、絶対、来月、誕生日よね、メイちゃん、お祝い、絶対、本気で、用意してるからね、本気で、約束、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Your birthday's next month, right? I'm already working on something special for you—I promise.
lines.style: Bright, forward-looking warmth. Playful certainty in the promise. She's delighted to have something planned. Leaning in slightly, conspiratorial.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お店、ガラス越しに、本気で、絶対、お客様、覗くと、メイちゃんも、お洒落な、お席、絶対、見えるわよね、本気で、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: You know, when I look through the shop window from outside, I can see your seat from my place. It's nice to know you're there.
lines.style: Quiet, intimate observation. Slow, gentle delivery. A moment of connection—not sentimental, but real and close. Trailing slightly, like sharing a secret.
